title: Construction of the normalized prelog inverse image
statement: For every scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and Zariski prelog sheaf $P$ [def-trf-zariski-log-structure], the type PrelogEtaleInverseImage$(P)$ [def-trf-prelog-logification-data] is inhabited. Its raw diagram is the prescribed open-image diagram, its unit is monoid sheafification, and its structural map agrees on raw sections with pullback of regular functions. No Noetherianity hypothesis is needed.

source.place: ILO VIII, opening of section 3, p.97, and 3.3.2, p.106; arbitrary-prelog formulation and detailed proof expanded by the agent from the parent node.

proof.text: Define the raw structural map on W by beta on image(W) followed by prelogImageFunctions. Scheme.Hom.map_appLE and appLE_comp_appLE prove naturality. Sheafify this monoid diagram. The filtered-colimit construction supplies the small filtered colimits needed by the concrete sheafification instance on a small model of the affine-etale site; dense-site equivalence transports sheafification to the small etale site. The multiplicative structure presheaf is a sheaf by Scheme.isSheaf_etaleStructurePresheaf. The sheafifyLift API supplies its structural extension and the unit equation, and the sheafification adjunction supplies the required Hom bijection. This is a direct use of Mathlib constructions, not a choice from an unproved existence statement.

mathlib_searches.query: Sheafification of the unit pushout of an arbitrary prelog sheaf gives associated log structures; inverse image on the etale site and characteristic monoid stalks commute with this construction.

Read Sheafification.lean, LeftExact.lean, ConcreteSheafification.lean and PreservesSheafification.lean. They provide the general sheafification API but no logarithmic construction, comparison, or characteristic-stalk statement.
